edges.fact: Garmin Express is software developed by Garmin, downloaded to calibrate a Garmin bike computer via USB.
Garmin bike computers support enabling GPS to receive satellite signals from the American GPS system for accurate location data.
Garmin bike computers support enabling GLONASS (if available) to receive satellite signals from the Russian GLONASS system for more accurate location data.
